name: panel-bottom-close
useCase: Close the bottom panel in a workspace or editor.
misuse: Do not use this physical panel control as a page navigation arrow.

16.reason: The inset panel divider leaves 1px before the chevron; the shared frame and mirrored divider positions stay consistent across the panel family.

24.reason: The larger divider and chevron retain their original proportions with at least 1.5px of space, using matched positions across the panel family.
